question.prompt: \(a=(1,0,0)\), \(b=(2,0,0)\). The two vectors have the same direction. How many times \(|a|\) is \(|b|\)?

solutions.explanation: Their magnitudes are 1 and 2, respectively, so \(|b|\) is 2 times \(|a|\). The two vectors have the same direction but different magnitudes, so they are not equal.
solutions.title: Compare the magnitudes
